verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question for an API gateway, so the axis applies. The pack shows static docs: a quickstart code snippet, markdown pages and an llms.txt index. Nothing shows an interactive "try it" reference or runnable examples, and every OpenAPI spec path the probe tried returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
